name: Community Events Mini
summary: Publish small community events and let signed-in members manage their own RSVPs.
description: Community Events Mini adds a focused events directory to pH7Builder without introducing a calendar platform or external service.
Operators can publish an event with a title, description, venue and capacity. Members can RSVP or withdraw, while the module keeps attendance counts without exposing the attendee list publicly.
outcomes: Give a dating or community product a practical reason for members to return.
Run online or in-person events without sending member data to another platform.
Keep event publishing and attendance inside the existing pH7Builder administration model.

decision.buyer: Dating and community operators who want to create recurring reasons for members to meet and return.
bestFor: Small online or in-person gatherings managed by the site operator.
Communities that want RSVPs without exposing a public attendee directory.
Operators who prefer a focused native module over another external service.
decision.notFor: A full ticketing, venue-management or public event marketplace.
decision.timeToValue: Install the module, review its settings and publish the first event from the existing administration area.

contents: Optional pH7Builder module with public event pages

steps: Back up the application files and database.
Open the pH7Builder admin panel and install Community Events Mini from Modules.
Review the new module before publishing the first event.
installation.uninstall: Use the module manager to uninstall the module. Uninstalling removes the module tables and their event data after the administrator confirms the action.

support.policy: Installation questions and reproducible defects are covered by email for 30 days. Customisation and operating advice are not included.

items: Adds member RSVP and withdrawal actions.
Adds capacity enforcement and private attendance counts.
